caveats: All values are model estimates; `observed=false` and `policy_grade=false`.
The 100/119/150 Mm3 cases are planning allocations, not legal AACs, sustainable-supply determinations, or observed harvest outcomes.
The 1.2x provincial floor is recomputed from each case's harvest. Proxy capacities only are scaled; published capacity is never altered, and scaled proxies are not observed capacity.
Capacity v3 mixes published mill records and class-median proxy capacity. The bases are not interchangeable.
The allocation is local first; cross-border volume is only the residual that local finite capacity cannot serve.
Product and residue quantities apply measured four-province product-chain-v2 coefficients to assigned class feedstock. They are not measured mill output.
Process residue is facility-assigned and separate from provincial harvest residue; harvest residue is never assigned to a facility.
The 150m documented ceiling is not the 1.0 or 1.2 m3/ha/yr operable-proxy intensity screen. Both intensity screens are infeasible at 150 Mm3 and are reported separately.
No UI or public OSeCAN surface is changed by this artifact.
BC, QC, NB and YT use measured bucking-pilot product shares; the other nine jurisdictions keep donor coefficients. This is a four-province pilot, not a national measured coefficient set.

Taper coverage is local for BC and QC, donor for NB and YT. Unsupported species and out-of-domain stems are excluded, so the measured coefficients do not represent full provincial species coverage; hardwood limitations remain.
E2c is an open-data density calibration, not measured inventory. SK/NS/PE use open stem density, MB uses donor median density and AB/ON/NL/NT/NU retain a labelled 1,000 stems/ha proxy.
Density calibration is extensive: it changes stems/ha expansion and the expanded reference volume, not per-m3 product or residue coefficients.
Total harvest residue includes CFS branch and foliage dry mass. Branch and foliage have no measured volume, so products and process residue are not increased by that dry mass.
0.35/0.60/0.75 recovery scenarios are carried with equal status; 0.60 is a reference value, not a calibrated recovery factor.

intensity_note.conflation_warning: The 1.0 and 1.2 m3/ha/yr operable-proxy screens are infeasible at 150 Mm3. They are separate sensitivity results and must not be used to relabel or reject the documented 150m ceiling case.
intensity_note.documented_ceiling_note: The 150m scenario uses the documented provincial ceiling table. It is not an operable-proxy intensity screen.

method.assignment: assignment-v6 province_capacity_floor, local-first, finite capacity, 500 km cross-border penalty
method.product_residue: E1 measured and E2c density-calibrated product-chain-v5 coefficients applied to assigned class feedstock; donor within-class splits and class ratios

product_chain.conversion: E1 measured and E2c density-calibrated provincial solid/pulp/other shares with donor within-class splits and class conversion ratios; E1 measured and E2c stem + branch + foliage total residue

scope: 100/119/150 Mm3 facility chain with E1 measured product coefficients for BC/QC/NB/YT and E2c density-calibrated product coefficients for the other nine; total harvest residue includes CFS branch and foliage.

v3_2_vs_v4.baseline_note: The committed v3.2 chain uses E2 v1, not E2 v2. E2 v2 and E2c share per-m3 coefficients, so the deltas are E2 v1 to E2c coefficient effects at fixed assignment and harvest.

coefficients.explanation: v3.2 uses the E2 v1 product coefficients, not E2 v2. The v4 chain replaces them with E2c v3. Differences are E2 v1 to E2c coefficient effects at fixed assignment and harvest.

v3_2_vs_v4.prior_chain_label: frozen v3.2 chain with E2 v1 product coefficients
